BUILD · QUEUE YOUR DEFENCES
Open BUILD. Scroll the sidebar and choose a structure.
Tap each valid location. Queued sites appear as Warzone’s green building blueprints.
Visible trucks work together. BUILD selects the trucks in view; your later manual selection is retained when choosing a structure.
SELECT / MOVE leaves placement and keeps queued work. Placement also ends when your group finishes.

Invalid taps keep your chosen structure active. STOP cancels selected trucks’ orders, and clears their remaining native queued sites.

PROTECT YOUR COMMAND CENTRE

You have 3 minutes to prepare. Wave 1 starts automatically, even if you have not built anything. If your command centre is destroyed, you have failed.

The mod schedules 30 rounds. Later rounds arrive on their own timer; surviving enemies stay. SKIP WAVE calls the next round early. Destroying enemies awards power.

MOVE & LOOK

Tap to select, move or attack. Swipe to pan. Pinch to zoom. Slide two fingers together up/down to tilt the camera. Map edges limit panning. SELECT / MOVE returns to ordinary unit selection and orders. Tap BOX then drag to select a group.

NEAR / BATTLE / MAP set camera distance. BASE returns to your command centre.

COMMANDS & RESEARCH

On small screens, tap the bottom-left units icon to expand ALL UNITS, PATROL, BOX, STOP and TRUCKS. ALL selects combat units; TRUCKS selects the nearby constructor group. Control size and Commanders are at the top of this guide. STOP stops selected units.

TECH opens research. Choose a lab and add available topics to its queue. Each lab completes your choices in order. Use BACK TO BATTLE to return.

DESIGN creates blueprints from researched parts. SAVE DESIGN keeps them on this device. FACTORY produces saved or existing designs with normal power and build time.

MUSIC

Choose your tracks on the start screen before starting a battle. Download Music once, select your playlist, then press START GAME. Your choices are saved for the next game.

The battle continues while this guide is open.
